decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [GPG-P-A-A.00 Rev A, GPG-D-A-A.01 Rev A, GPG-D-A-A.02 Rev A, GPG-D-A-A.03 Rev A, GPG-D-A-A.04 Rev A, GPG-D-A-A.05 Rev A, GPG-D-A-A.06 Rev A, GPG-D-A-A.07 Rev A, GPG-D-A-A.11 Rev A, GPG-D-A-A.12 Rev A, GPG-D-A-A.13 Rev A, GPG-D-A-A.21 Rev A, GPG-D-A-A.22 Rev A, GPG-D-A-A.23 Rev A, GPG-D-A-A.24 Rev A, GPG-D-A-A.25 Rev A, GPG-D-A-W.01 Rev A, Design and access statement, Fire Safety Strategy, GPG-D-A-F.01 Rev A, Flood risk assessment, Noise Impact Assessment, Arboricultural method statement, Tree protection plan received 11/09/2025].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.

Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building, unless otherwise shown on the approved plans.
Reason: In order to safeguard the appearance of the area.

Condition : 4 - The detached single storey outbuilding hereby permitted shall only be used for a purpose incidental to the enjoyment of the house at the '41 Grove Park Gardens W4 3RY' described at the top of this decision letter and for no other purpose (for example, it may not be used as a self-contained dwelling or contain a bedroom, bathroom, kitchen or other primary residential accommodation, nor may it be used for business purposes). 
Reason: In order to protect neighbours' living conditions and the character of the area.

Condition : 5 - The trees that are specified on the drawings hereby approved to be retained shall be protected before commencement of any works on site and throughout the course of the development by methods that conform to the best practice guidance contained in British Standard BS5837: 2012 or any guidance that shall have superseded it

Reason: In order to ensure a satisfactory appearance of the site and the area and to promote biodiversity.

Condition : 6 - a) The cumulative measured or calculated rating level of noise emitted from the mechanical services plant including heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) to which this permission refers, shall be 10dB(A) below the existing background noise level, at all times that the plant operate. The measured or calculated noise levels shall be determined at the boundary of the nearest ground floor noise sensitive premises or one metre from the facade of the nearest first floor (or higher) noise sensitive premises, and in accordance to the latest British Standard 4142. An alternative position for assessment/measurement may be used to allow ease of access, this must be shown on a map and noise propagation calculations detailed to show how the design criteria are achieved. 

b) The plant shall be isolated on adequate proprietary anti-vibration mounts to prevent the structural transmission of vibration and regenerated noise within adjacent or adjoining premises, and these shall be so maintained thereafter.   

c) Following installation of any mechanical services plant including heating, ventilation and air conditioning (HVAC) to which the application refers, a post completion noise assessment shall be submitted for approval to the local planning authority which demonstrates the actual measured rating level of plant operating under normal conditions. All measurements shall be made in accordance with the methodology of BS4142: 2014 (Methods for rating and assessing industrial and commercial sound) and/or its subsequent amendments. The post completion report shall be both completed and submitted to the local authority within 28 days of completion of the installation for review. If the plant fails to meet the specified standard, remedial measures shall be put in place immediately and the noise assessment shall be carried out again.  This shall be repeated until the assessment has reached the required standard.  Once achieved, the plant shall be maintained permanently ther
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension, front porch extension, side roof extension with four roof windows, replacement of existing windows and doors with double glazed timber windows, erection of an outbuilding, enlargement of front access, installation of new gate and fence to the front boundary, installation of permeable paving to the front garden and installation of bike/bin storage and installation of external AC units to the house
